question: What does registration revision 3 specify that the pilot never used?

specified.note: 13 coefficients incl. c0 + deltas + delta-deltas, librosa, 25 ms window / 10 ms hop. Features with no learned structure.

Run in the span grid's pooled design (2026-10-29), on the 10,334 sites under joint: best layer 9 on every span, balanced accuracy 0.616–0.625. Ahead of MFCC on every span (C5). Index 0 is not the CNN output but LayerNorm(projection + positional conv), so it carries position (span grid §8).
Index 0 is the input to the first layer; 1–12 are layer outputs. Pretraining data not yet checked against the paper.

answer:
Of the items listed as specified, only one never appears in the pilot run: the **facebook/wav2vec2-base** representation, which has an **exploratory** role [rep-wav2vec2]. Every other specified item lists run-pilot among its users.

The pilot skipped wav2vec2, but the study did use it later. It was run in the span grid's pooled design (2026-10-29) on the 10,334 sites under the joint condition. There its best layer was 9 on every span, with balanced accuracy of 0.616–0.625, ahead of MFCC on every span (C5) [rep-wav2vec2]. It also appears in run-rep-communities [rep-wav2vec2]. Its index 0 is not the CNN output but LayerNorm(projection + positional conv), so it carries position information [rep-wav2vec2].

Three items reached the pilot, but some of their notes are worth knowing:
- **WavJEPA** (primary): its pretraining data has "not yet checked against the paper," an open point [rep-wavjepa].
- **MFCC** (baseline): described as features with no learned structure [rep-mfcc].
- **The [ɾ] environment** (primary): used in the pilot and later runs [env-flap].

One caveat: the rows don't explicitly label this list as registration revision 3. I'm assuming the "specified" set corresponds to that revision.
